meta.title: Free fallin'
meta.subtitle: OECD-23 countries, average PISA test scores
meta.source: OECD, PISA 2025 Results (Volume I), Table I.D.1 (Overview of performance trends), https://stat.link/urv65o. Underlying tables I.B1.2a.36, I.B1.2a.37 and I.B1.2a.38.
meta.definition: OECD-23: the arithmetic mean of the 23 OECD countries with comparable reading results in every PISA round from 2000 to 2025. Science starts in 2006 and mathematics in 2003, the first rounds with a comparable scale.
meta.significantNote: Significant is true when the country mean differs from its PISA 2025 mean at the 5% level (a filled dot in the OECD figure).
